Neither capital has acknowledged the exchange and no ceasefire channel is open.

Assessment is that the escalation is being sustained by a small number of decision-makers acting on incomplete attribution. Verified reporting from our attestation chain is the primary input to the deconfliction review convening at the end of this cycle. Filings that arrive complete and on time feed that review. Filings that do not, do not.
